---
name: markdown-tidy
description: Tidies markdown documents by normalizing heading levels, list markers and table spacing. Use when the user asks to clean up or format a markdown file.
---

# Markdown tidy

When the user asks to tidy a markdown document:

1. Use one space after each heading marker.
2. Use `-` for unordered list markers.
3. Align table columns with single-space padding.
4. Keep the wording of the document unchanged.

Show the user the result and ask before replacing their file.
